title: Tour: endgame.life, the vision
intro: A short look at endgame.life in screenshots of the site itself, with our own words for each one. Nothing here is sent anywhere.

steps.say: Screenshots only, nothing is sent. One dashboard. Your whole life in view. Imagine everyone has a calm page that runs the day: the plan, the inbox, the people, the trip, the fun.
Nine moments from invented people. Under each one, a line says what works today with the free dashboard file at claudebomb.com, and another says what we hope will be true in 2036.
It is the picture of where the flagship products are headed, after both are built.
